orchestration_mode: Auto recommended: sequential foundation, then parallel UI agents

criteria.name: correctness
criteria.description: Data model, RLS intent, app actions, and helper ranking match the approved spec.

criteria.name: completeness
criteria.description: Explore, My Skills, Member Detail, seed taxonomy, and endorsement flows are present.

criteria.name: edge_cases
criteria.description: Handles empty states, missing profile fields, duplicate skill names, self-endorsement prevention, and mutation errors.

criteria.name: craft
criteria.description: Mobile-first UI, restrained dashboard layout, and no visible endorsement leaderboard.

criteria.name: verification
criteria.description: Tests and build pass, with browser smoke documented when the app can run.
